title: My Brother Forged Docs, Sold My Plane, Left Me $88K In Debt. So I Made Him The Lavatory Guy.
description: I drained my $88,000 403(b) to co-sign a lease on a Cessna with my brother, who forged documents making me only a guarantor, then sold the aircraft's FAA certificate and the plane for $400,000, leaving me with the debt. A forgotten VHS tape of our handshake contract from Mom's 90th birthday surfaced and became Exhibit A in a federal wire fraud trial, winning me a $320,000 judgment plus the repossessed aircraft. Now I run Sky Justice Air Tours where he scrubs lavatories and wears a 'Flight Risk' cap while every boarding pass prints his fraud case number. #SkyJustice #FamilyBetrayal #RevengeTour
thumb_text: HE SOLD MY PLANE, NOW HE SCRUBS LAVATORIES
pinned_comment: If your brother forged documents to steal your plane and left you $88,000 in debt, would you have tracked down a VHS tape from your mom's 90th birthday to win a judgment and put him in a 'Flight Risk' cap? Tell me your story in the comments.
